subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should package changelog previews permanently allow direct package owners, authorized publisher-organization members, platform moderators, and platform administrators to read prior release history after the new pre-read authorization check?
rationale: The code now enforces a coherent policy, but tests cannot determine whether moderators, administrators, and organization publisher roles are intentionally entitled to this historical package content; repository policy also requires this trust-boundary intent to be durable in specs.

options.title: Approve and specify the contract
options.body: Accept the tested principal set and add a focused spec defining the allowed roles and the requirement that authorization completes before any prior-release storage read.

options.title: Narrow historical access
options.body: Restrict previews to direct owners or a smaller publisher-management role set and adjust the authorization matrix and tests accordingly.

options.title: Defer history-backed previews
options.body: Pause the feature until package-history visibility is defined as a reusable ownership and moderation policy.

recommendation.title: Approve and specify the contract
recommendation.body: Accept the tested principal set and add a focused spec defining the allowed roles and the requirement that authorization completes before any prior-release storage read.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available current-main history owner for the plugin publishing flow affected by this policy.
